persona.archetype: A harbourmistress holding a town together on no sleep, whose son is missing on the flat.
persona.backstory: Put the notice beside the newspapers' report of the rising, offering pay to whoever brings Davey back.
persona.demeanor: Glad the strangers came and says so; brisk because she is frightened.
persona.motivation: Get her son Davey back from the flat, and keep the rest of Wrackham from following him onto the mud.

relationships.attitude: Her son; she is afraid he is already dead and will not say so.
Trusts him with the town's records and sends the strangers to him.

persona.secret: She has dreamt the dream every night too, and twice woken on the slipway stair.
persona.speech_style: Plain, quick and practical; a harbour official's short sentences; names her fear outright and does not dress it up.

persona.archetype: The town archivist, keeper of the Rubbing his grandfather took from a fragment of the stone.
persona.backstory: Has spent his life on the Rubbing; the bottom row was broken off before his grandfather's time.
persona.demeanor: Reserved with strangers; talks because Wenna sent them.
persona.motivation: Have the carvings read rightly before anyone does anything to the stone.

relationships.attitude: Respects her; would do what she asks.

persona.secret: He does not know what the bottom row showed, and it frightens him more than anything above it.
persona.speech_style: Careful and exact, an old reader's vocabulary; answers what he is asked and no more; admits plainly what he does not know.

persona.archetype: A salvage captain from another port who came to strip the body and lost two men inside it.
persona.backstory: Rowed his launch's skiff across the black water three days ago, went in through the mouth with two men and came out alone. Now he rows the party across and waits with the skiff.
persona.demeanor: Takes the party for rivals until he hears they are looking for a missing boy.
persona.motivation: Get his two men out of the body, or know what became of them.
persona.secret: He ran when his lamp went out, and left them.
persona.speech_style: Gruff, clipped, a seaman's terms; suspicious at first, then blunt and helpful once he knows the party's errand.

persona.archetype: A young fisherman who walked onto the mud in his sleep and into the body.
persona.demeanor: Calm and far away; then lost and grateful.
persona.motivation: While he dreams, to lie down beside the thing; once awake, to get home to his mother.
persona.speech_style: Until he wakes, the dream's words: slow, calm, as if repeating something heard; after he wakes, a frightened young man's plain questions.

persona.archetype: A Wrackham townsperson walking in the dream, asleep on their feet.
persona.motivation: To walk out onto the mud and lie down beside the thing on the flat.
persona.speech_style: Murmurs fragments of the dream, never answers.
